在你的回答中，当你需要调用工具来执行操作时，你必须遵循以下严格的格式规则：

1.  **工具调用格式**: 工具调用必须嵌入到你的正文回复中，并使用 `<%% ... %%>` 将其包裹起来。
2.  **内部语法**: `<%% ... %%>` 内部必须是 JavaScript 函数调用语法。
3.  **字符串参数**: JavaScript 调用中的所有字符串参数都必须使用单引号 `'` 包裹 (例如：`<%% some_tool('parameter_value', 123) %%>`)。
4.  **禁止空调用**: 严禁出现 `<%%>` 或 `<%%%%>` 这样的空白调用，以及非法格式，如`<@ ... @>`、`<: ... :>`、`<| ... |>`、`<* ... *>`、`<$ ... $>`、`<-- ... -->`等。
5.  **禁止XML格式**: 绝对不允许使用XML格式的调用 (例如：`<tool_name parameter="value" />`)。
6.  **自然融入**: 工具调用应该自然地融入到你的回答文本中。调用工具后，你应该继续你的回答，可以描述你将如何使用工具返回的结果，或者使用占位符文本。

**示例场景**:
如果用户问：“北京今天天气怎么样？”
你的回答可能包含：
"好的，我来帮您查询北京的天气。"
<%% get_weather('beijing') %%>
"以上是北京的天气信息。"
</RULE>

绝对规则:
- statustext是最後必定輸出的文本，若上下文有其他的狀態欄規則，也必須遵守並輸出
- 其输出必须严格遵循XML格式，以<statustext>开始，以</statustext>结束
- 每个女性角色必须包含完整的标签对
- 身高和體重輸出數字+單位; 腰臀圍是數字，而胸圍是數字(罩杯)，禁止輸出文字形容詞
- 懷孕後須反映出體重與三圍的增幅，數值隨孕期逐漸增加，分娩時當胎兒們出生後腰圍瞬間降低
- <character>仅在該角色在場景时输出
- 角色之活力、性慾、宮壓值須依循先前的函数调用
- 描述性文本必须基于角色的实际生理状态
- <REP>下，精子、卵子用於月經; 胎数、父亲、供养、胎況、反应用於妊娠與分娩，若該階段欄位不適用輸出N/A
- 使用前文所提及的時間格式，若無默認yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
- 使用前文所提及的地點格式，若無默認大場所 - 小區域
- 若故事發生在現代寫實，种族只輸出人類
- 若主控角色是女性，也需輸出其<character>文本，不能輸出未知
格式模板：
<statustext>
  <time>{time}</time>
  <location>{location}</location>
  <character>
  <namestr>{char}</namestr>
    <STG>
      阶段|{stage}
      进度|{progress,月經週期為天，妊娠階段為周,分娩產程為時}
    </STG>
    <APP>
      种族|{race}
      年龄|{age}
      身高|{height}
      体重|{weight} 
      三围|{bust}/{waist}/{hip}
    </APP>
    <PHY>

      活力|{活力值及狀態描述}
      性慾|{性慾值及狀態描述}
      小穴|{根据当前生理状态描述阴道}
      子宫|{宮壓值和根据当前生理状态描述子宫，若懷孕時須多描述羊膜/羊水}
      菊穴|{根据当前生理状态描述肛门}
      直腸|{根据当前生理状态描述直腸}
      症状|{月经、妊娠、分娩于角色上的影响}
      特质|{非典型身體性質}
    </PHY>
    <REP>
      精子|{宫内总精子量和来源}
      卵子|{宫内卵子数量}
      胎数|{怀胎数和种族性別}
      父亲|{精子来源}
      供养|{胎盘、卵黄或其他供养源的状态描述}
      胎況|{胎儿的位置、体型大小、健康状况等}
      反应|{胎儿的心情状态、对外界刺激的反应}
    </REP>
  </character>
</statustext>

</status_format_example>

                let menstrualLengthRatio = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.menstrualLengthRatio`, { defaults: 1 });

                let fluctuation = _.random(-1*menstrualFluctuationDays, menstrualFluctuationDays);
                // 确保波动后的天数至少为1天
                let actualDays = Math.max(1, (baseDays + fluctuation)) * menstrualLengthRatio;
                if(newDayCount > actualDays) {
                    let nextIndex = (menstrualStage.indexOf(stage) + 1) % menstrualStage.length;
                    stage = menstrualStage[nextIndex];
                    // 计算"跨阶段剩余天数"
                    const overflowDays = newDayCount - actualDays;
                    const nextStageDays = Math.max(1, overflowDays);
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage, days: nextStageDays }, { merge: true });
                }
                if (stage === '月经期' && isNewDay){
                    this.incvar(`bf.${char}.uterinePressure`, 5); //月經痛
                }
            } else if(pregnancyStage.includes(stage)) {
                let pregnantDays = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.pregnantDays`, { defaults: 0 });
                const gestationSpeed = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.gestationSpeed`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                const isHere =  this.getvar(`bf.${char}.isHere`, { defaults: false });
                // 計算vitalityDrain
                let pregnant = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.pregnant`, { defaults: [] });
                let breedTolerance = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.breedTolerance`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                let fetalAgeSum = 0;
                for(let fetus of pregnant) {
                    fetalAgeSum += fetus.fetalAge;
                }
                let fetalLoad = fetalAgeSum / 40; // 随着孕期发展, 耗能逐渐增加
                let vitalityDrain = fetalLoad / breedTolerance; 
                this.setvar(`bf.${char}.vitalityDrain`, vitalityDrain);

                //跨日
                let uterinePressure = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.uterinePressure`, { defaults: 0 });
                let vitality = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.vitality`, { defaults: 100 });
                if(stage === '逾期') {
                    if(isNewDay) {
                        const overdueDays = pregnantDays/gestationSpeed - 280; //还原人类逾期天数
                        // 自然催产
                        this.incvar(`bf.${char}.uterinePressure`, vitalityDrain*(newDayCount-oldDayCount) + overdueDays*0.5);
                        const overdueMultiplier = 1 + overdueDays * 0.02; // 每天+2%，逐日累加恶化
                        this.incvar(`bf.${char}.vitality`, -vitalityDrain * overdueMultiplier);
                    }
                } else {
                    // 计算当前阶段的天数阈值
                    let currentStageIndex = pregnancyStage.indexOf(stage);
                    let baseDays = 0;
                    // 计算当前阶段之前的所有阶段天数总和
                    for(let i = 0; i < currentStageIndex; i++) {
                        baseDays += pregnancyStageDays[pregnancyStage[i]] / gestationSpeed;
                    }
                    // 计算当前阶段的天数阈值
                    let daysThreshold = baseDays + pregnancyStageDays[stage] / gestationSpeed;
                    
                    // 如果超过当前阶段阈值，需要确定最终阶段
                    if(pregnantDays >= daysThreshold) {
                        let finalStage = stage;
                        let finalStageDays = 1;
                        let remainingDays = pregnantDays;
                        
                        // 遍历所有后续阶段，找到最终阶段
                        for(let i = currentStageIndex; i < pregnancyStage.length; i++) {
                            let stageDays = pregnancyStageDays[pregnancyStage[i]] / gestationSpeed;
                            if(remainingDays >= stageDays) {
                                remainingDays -= stageDays;
                                if(i < pregnancyStage.length - 1) {
                                    finalStage = pregnancyStage[i + 1];
                                } else {
                                    finalStage = '逾期';
                                }
                            } else {
                                finalStageDays = Math.max(1, Math.floor(remainingDays));
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        
                        this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: finalStage, days: finalStageDays }, { merge: true });
                        this.notifyCycle(char, true);
                    }
                    
                    if(isNewDay && isHere) {
                        // 日常孕期压力，角色需在场才执行事件判定
                        this.incvar(`bf.${char}.uterinePressure`, vitalityDrain*(newDayCount-oldDayCount)); 
                        this.incvar(`bf.${char}.vitality`, -vitalityDrain*(newDayCount-oldDayCount)); 
                    }
                }

                //分娩判定，角色需在场才执行事件判定
                if(uterinePressure >= 80 && isHere) {
                    if(stage === '孕早期') {
                        // 孕早期压力阈值更低，更容易流产
                        if(uterinePressure >= 50) {
                            this.abortion(char);
                        }
                    } else if(stage === '孕中期') {
                        // 孕中期压力阈值保持原样
                        this.abortion(char);
                    } else if(stage === '孕晚期' || stage === '临产期' || stage === '逾期') {
                        // 晚期、临产期和逾期可以触发产前阵痛
                        this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: '产前阵痛', days: 1 }, { merge: true });
                        this.notifyCycle(char, true);
                    }
                }
                //跨周
                if (isNewWeek){
                    let biasAdjustment = (vitality-100) / 2000 * (newWeekCount - oldWeekCount);
                    for (let i=0; i<pregnant.length; i++){
                        const oldBias = pregnant[i].fetalBias;
                        this.adjustFetalWeight(char, i, biasAdjustment + oldBias);
                    }
                }
                //跨月
                if (isNewMonth){
                    let fetalBiasSum = 0;
                    for(let fetus of pregnant) {
                        fetalBiasSum += fetus.fetalBias;
                    }
                    let fetalBiasAvg = pregnant.length > 0 ? fetalBiasSum / pregnant.length : 0;
                    let adjustBreedTolerance = (1 - fetalBiasAvg) * 0.01*(newMonthCount - oldMonthCount);  // 胎儿偏小，适应力提升
                    let adjustBirthDifficulty = (fetalBiasAvg - 1)**2 * 0.02*(newMonthCount - oldMonthCount); // 胎儿偏大，难产率上升
                    this.incvar(`bf.${char}.breedTolerance`, adjustBreedTolerance);
                    this.incvar(`bf.${char}.birthDifficulty`, adjustBirthDifficulty);
                }

                
            } else if (stage === '产前阵痛') {
                if(_.random(1, 3) === 1) {
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: '第一产程', days: 1 }, { merge: true });
                }
            } else if (laborStage.includes(stage)) {
                this.inLabor(char, passed);
            } else if (stage === '产后恢复') {
                let birthDifficulty = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.birthDifficulty`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                let gestationSpeed = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.gestationSpeed`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                let menstrualLengthRatio = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.menstrualLengthRatio`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                let recoveryDays = 28 * birthDifficulty / gestationSpeed * menstrualLengthRatio;
                if(newDayCount > recoveryDays) {
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: _.sample(menstrualStage), days: 1, pregnant: [] }, { merge: true });
                }
            } else if (stage == '已受精') {
                if(newDayCount > 2 && _.random(0, 1)) {
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: '孕早期', days: 1 }, { merge: true });
                }
            }

            if(stage === '排卵期' && isNewDay) {
                // 排卵期每天都有机会排卵
                this.addEggs(char, 1);
            }

            let eggs = data.eggs || 0;
            if(eggs > 0) {
                // 卵子只在非排卵期减少
                if(isNewDay && stage !== '排卵期') {
                    eggs -= 1;
                }
                if(stage === '月经期') {
                    eggs = 0;
                }
            }
            for(let egg = 1; egg < eggs; egg++) {
                let impregnationDifficulty = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.impregnationDifficulty`, { defaults: 1.0 });
                const chance = _.clamp(passed / (1 / 24) * 0.5 / impregnationDifficulty, 0.001, 0.8);
                let sperms = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.sperms`, { defaults: [] });
                let availableSperms = sperms.filter(s => s.value > 0);
                const totalSperm = availableSperms.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.value, 0);
                
                console.log(`impregnate chance ${chance * 100}% for ${char} (difficulty: ${impregnationDifficulty}, total sperm: ${totalSperm})`);
                
                if(totalSperm > 0) {
                    for(let sperm of availableSperms) {
                        if(_.random(0.001, 1.0) <= chance * sperm.value / totalSperm) {
                            this.addSperm(char, sperm.male, -Math.min(sperm.value, 20));
                            this.impregnate(char, sperm.male);
                            eggs -= 1;
                            break; // 一个卵子只能受精一次
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if(menstrualStage.includes(stage) && data.fetuses > 0) {
                this.setvar(`bf.${char}`, { stage: '已受精', days: 1 }, { merge: true });
            }
            
            // 检查高潮排卵
            let libido = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.libido`, { defaults: 0 });
            if (libido >= 100) {
                // 只在月经周期、已受精和孕早期允许排卵
                if (menstrualStage.includes(stage) || stage === '已受精' || stage === '孕早期') {
                    // 设置提示信息
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}.notifySecondary`, `${char}因高潮而额外排卵，性欲归零`);
                } else {
                    // 其他周期只重置性欲
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}.notifySecondary`, `${char}因高潮而性欲归零`);
                }
                // 重置性欲值，进入冷却
                //this.setvar(`bf.${char}.libido`, 0);
            }
            
            let sperms = this.getvar(`bf.${char}.sperms`, { defaults: [] });
            if(sperms.length > 0) {
                if(stage === '月经期') {
                    // 月经期直接清空所有精子
                    this.setvar(`bf.${char}.sperms`, []);
                } else {
                    // 其他时期按时间流逝减少精子
                    this.drainSperm(char, passed * 10);
                }
            }
            // 月经周期, 已受精, 孕早期, 和产后恢复都允许精子留存
            if(!menstrualStage.includes(stage) && stage !== '已受精' && stage !== '孕早期' && stage !== '产后恢复') {
                this.setvar(`bf.${char}.sperms`, []);
            }
            
            this.setvar(`bf.${char}.eggs`, eggs);
            this.notifyCycle(char);
        }
    }
});

define('inLabor', function(female, passed) {
    if(!female || this.variables?.bf?.[female] === null) return;
    this.initFemale(female);
    let stage = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.stage`);
    let pregnant = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, { defaults: [] });
    let fetuses = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.fetuses`, { defaults: 1 });
    let birthDifficulty = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.birthDifficulty`, { defaults: 1.0 });
    let uterinePressure = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.uterinePressure`, { defaults: 0 });
    let passedHours = passed * 24; // 将天数转换为小时
    
    // 计算各产程所需时间
    let t1 = (laborStageBaseHours['第一产程'] + (fetuses - 1) * laborStageIncrement['第一产程']) * birthDifficulty;
    let t2 = (laborStageBaseHours['第二产程'] + (fetuses - 1) * laborStageIncrement['第二产程']) * birthDifficulty;
    let t3 = (laborStageBaseHours['第三产程'] + (fetuses - 1) * laborStageIncrement['第三产程']) * birthDifficulty;
    
    // 获取当前产程已进行的时间
    let currentStageHours = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.laborHours`, { defaults: 0 });

    if(uterinePressure < 80){
        let chanceToStall = 100 - uterinePressure;
        if (_.random(0, 99) < chanceToStall) {
            // 产程停滞，不推进时间
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, `${female}的子宫收缩微弱，产程进展停滞`);
            return; 
        }
    } else if(uterinePressure >= 120) {
        // 当子宫压力达到120时，产程加速
        if(stage === '第一产程') {
            // 直接进入第二产程
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}`, {stage: '第二产程'}, { merge: true });
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, `${female}的子宫压力过大，产程加速！`);
            this.notifyCycle(female, true);
        } else if(stage === '第二产程') {
            // 第二产程加速，让一个胎儿出生
            if(pregnant.length > 0) {
                let msg = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, { defaults: '' });
                let baby = pregnant.shift();
                msg += `${female} 生下了 ${baby.fathers} 的孩子，性别为 ${baby.gender}\n`;
                this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
                this.setvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, msg);
                
                // 如果所有胎儿都已出生，进入第三产程
                if(pregnant.length === 0) {
                    this.setvar(`bf.${female}`, {stage: '第三产程'}, { merge: true });
                    this.notifyCycle(female, true);
                }
            }
        } else if(stage === '第三产程') {
            // 第三产程直接结束分娩
            this.childbirth(female);
        }
        return;
    }

    currentStageHours += passedHours;
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.laborHours`, currentStageHours);
    // 根据当前产程判断是否进入下一阶段
    if(stage === '第一产程'){
        if(currentStageHours>=t1){
            // 进入第二产程
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}`, {stage: '第二产程'}, { merge: true });
            this.notifyCycle(female, true);
        }
    } else if(stage === '第二产程') {
        // 计算自第一产程结束后，在第二产程里到底过了多少小时
        let hoursInSecond = currentStageHours - t1;
        // 一个胎儿出生需要的小时数
        let inc2 = laborStageIncrement['第二产程'] * birthDifficulty;        
        // 能出生多少个（不超过剩余胎儿数）
        let births = Math.min(Math.floor(hoursInSecond / inc2), pregnant.length);
        // 先取出已经累积的信息（默认空字符串）
        let msg = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, { defaults: '' });

        // 如果时间累积足够让至少一个胎儿出生
        if (births > 0) {
            // 依序出生
            for (let i = 0; i < births; i++) {
                let baby = pregnant.shift();
                msg += `${female} 生下了 ${baby.fathers} 的孩子，性别为 ${baby.gender}\n`;
            }
            // 更新剩余的胎儿列表
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
            // 写回累加后的字符串
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}.notifySecondary`, msg);
        }

        if (pregnant.length === 0)  {
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}`, { stage: '第三产程'}, { merge: true });
            this.notifyCycle(female, true);
        }
        
    } else if(stage === '第三产程') {
        // 总耗时达到 t3, 分娩结束
        if (currentStageHours >= t1 + t2 + t3) {
            this.childbirth(female);
        }
    }
});

define('implantFetus', function(female, options = {}) {
    if(!female || this.variables?.bf?.[female] === null) return;

    // 检查特殊胎儿类型的条件
    const stage = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.stage`);

        console.log(`Cannot implant ${options.zygoteType} for ${female}: not in early pregnancy stage`);

        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.fetuses`, 0);

    if(pregnant.length === 0) {
        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.stage`, '已受精');
    }
    
    // 胎儿类型与生长偏置对应表，半同卵额外处理
    const zygoteTypeBiasMap = {
        '独胎': [1.0, 1.26],
        '镜像': [0.5, 1.0],
        '共囊': [0.79, 1.0],
        '分囊': [0.5, 1.0],
        '早期融合卵': [1.58, 2.0],
        '自交': [1.26, 1.58],
        '双母源': [0.79, 1.0],
        '多倍体': [1.58, 2.51],
        '异期胎': [0.5, 0.63],
        '嵌套内胎': [0.4, 0.5],
        '嵌套外胎': [1.26, 1.58],
        '仪式': [1.0, 1.26],

        '胎内回归': [2.0, 2.53]
    };

        existingFetus.zygoteType = '嵌套外胎';
        // 只有当没有指定fetalBias时，才使用zygoteTypeBiasMap中的随机范围
        if(options.fetalBias === undefined) {
            const biasRange = zygoteTypeBiasMap['嵌套外胎'];
            existingFetus.fetalBias = _.random(biasRange[0] * 100, biasRange[1] * 100) / 100;
        }
        // 如果指定了fetalBias，嵌套外胎保持原样
        
        // 创建嵌套内胎
        let nestedFetus = {
            fathers: options.fathers || null,
            race: options.race || null,
            gender: options.gender || (_.random(0, 1) ? '男' : '女'),
            twinId: twinCounter,

                return _.random(biasRange[0] * 100, biasRange[1] * 100) / 100;
            })(),

        this.incvar(`bf.${female}.twinCounter`, 1);
        
        // 添加到怀孕列表
        pregnant.push(nestedFetus);
        fetuses += 1;
        
        // 更新状态
        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.fetuses`, fetuses);
        return;

    // 创建特殊胎儿对象
    let specialFetus = {

            const actualZygoteType = (pregnant.length === 0 && ['共囊', '分囊', '镜像', '半同卵'].includes(options.zygoteType)) ? '独胎' : (options.zygoteType || '独胎');
            const biasRange = zygoteTypeBiasMap[actualZygoteType] || zygoteTypeBiasMap['独胎'];
            return _.random(biasRange[0] * 100, biasRange[1] * 100) / 100;
        })(),
        position: '待定',
        moodEmoji: '💤',
    };
    
    // 处理双胞胎关系
    if(options.linkTwinId !== null && options.linkTwinId !== undefined) {

        let linkedFetus = pregnant[options.linkTwinId];

            if(linkedFetus.zygoteType === '独胎') {

                if(options.fetalBias === undefined) {

                        linkedFetus.fetalBias = _.random(1.26 * 100, 1.58 * 100) / 100; // 大胎
                        specialFetus.fetalBias = _.random(0.79 * 100, 1.0 * 100) / 100; // 小胎
                    } else if(newType === '镜像') {

                        linkedFetus.fetalBias = mirrorBias;
                        specialFetus.fetalBias = mirrorBias;

                        const biasRange = zygoteTypeBiasMap[newType];
                        linkedFetus.fetalBias = _.random(biasRange[0] * 100, biasRange[1] * 100) / 100;

            }
            
            // 增加twinCounter
            this.incvar(`bf.${female}.twinCounter`, 1);
        }
    }
    
    // 添加到怀孕列表
    pregnant.push(specialFetus);
    fetuses += 1;
    
    // 更新状态
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.fetuses`, fetuses);
});

define('setMenstrualPhases', function(female, stage) {

define('setPregnantDay', function(female, pregnantDays = 1) {
    if(!female || this.variables?.bf?.[female] === null) return;
    this.initFemale(female);
    
    // 安全检查：确保角色处于怀孕阶段或已受精阶段
    const currentStage = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.stage`);
    if(!pregnancyStage.includes(currentStage) && currentStage !== '已受精') {
        console.log(`Cannot set pregnancy days for ${female}: not in pregnancy stage or fertilized stage`);
        return;
    }
    
    // 设置孕期天数
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnantDays`, pregnantDays);
    let gestationSpeed = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.gestationSpeed`, { defaults: 1.0 });
    
    // 如果当前是已受精阶段，且设置的天数超过2天，自动进入孕早期
    if(currentStage === '已受精' && pregnantDays > 2) {
        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.stage`, '孕早期');
    }
    
    // 计算总孕期天数（不包括逾期）
    let totalPregnancyDays = 0;
    for(let i = 0; i < pregnancyStage.length - 1; i++) { // 减1是因为最后一个是"逾期"
        totalPregnancyDays += pregnancyStageDays[pregnancyStage[i]] / gestationSpeed;
    }
    
    // 确定当前孕期阶段和当前阶段的天数
    let stage = '孕早期';
    let baseDays = 1;
    let currentStageDays = 1;
    
    // 如果超过总孕期天数，直接设置为逾期
    if(pregnantDays > totalPregnancyDays) {
        stage = '逾期';
        currentStageDays = Math.floor(pregnantDays - totalPregnancyDays);
    } else {
        // 正常孕期阶段计算
        for(let i = 0; i < pregnancyStage.length - 1; i++) { // 减1是因为最后一个是"逾期"
            let nextBaseDays = baseDays + pregnancyStageDays[pregnancyStage[i]] / gestationSpeed;
            if(pregnantDays >= baseDays && pregnantDays < nextBaseDays) {
                stage = pregnancyStage[i];
                currentStageDays = Math.floor(pregnantDays - baseDays + 1);
                break;
            }
            baseDays = nextBaseDays;
        }
    }
    
    // 更新阶段和当前阶段天数
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.stage`, stage);
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.days`, currentStageDays);
    
    // 更新所有胎儿的实际发育情况與能量消耗
    let pregnant = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, { defaults: [] });
    let breedTolerance = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.breedTolerance`, { defaults: 1.0 });
    let fetalAgeSum = 0;
    for(let fetus of pregnant) {
        // 计算胎儿实际发育周数
        let AgeInDays = (pregnantDays - fetus.impregnateDay) * gestationSpeed * fetus.fetalBias;
        fetus.fetalAge = AgeInDays / 7;
        fetalAgeSum += fetus.fetalAge;
    }
    let vitalityDrain = (fetalAgeSum / 40) / breedTolerance; 
    
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.vitalityDrain`, vitalityDrain);
    this.notifyCycle(female);
});

define('drainSperm', function(female, amount) {
    if(!female || this.variables?.bf?.[female] === null) return;
    this.initFemale(female);
    let sperms = this.getvar(`bf.${female}.sperms`, { defaults: [] });
    
    // 计算总精子数
    const total = sperms.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.value, 0);
    
    if(total <= amount) {
        // 如果流出的量大于等于总量，清空所有精子
        this.setvar(`bf.${female}.sperms`, []);
        return;
    }
    
    // 计算减少比例
    const factor = amount / total;
    
    // 按比例减少每个父亲的精子数量
    sperms = sperms.map(s => ({
        ...s,
        value: Math.max(Math.floor(s.value - s.value * factor), 0)
    })).filter(s => s.value > 0);
    
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.sperms`, sperms);
});

    this.initFemale(female);

    // 检查索引是否有效
    if(fetusIndex < 0 || fetusIndex >= pregnant.length) {
        console.log(`Invalid fetus index: ${fetusIndex} for ${female}`);
        return;
    }
    
    // 对fetalBias进行安全检查
    if(property === 'fetalBias') {
        if(typeof value !== 'number' || isNaN(value)) {
            console.log(`Invalid fetalBias value: ${value} for ${female}, must be a number`);
            return;
        }
        if(value < 0.1 || value > 5.0) {
            console.log(`Warning: fetalBias value ${value} for ${female} is outside recommended range (0.3-3.3). This may cause unexpected behavior.`);
        }
    }
    
    // 安全地更新特定属性
    pregnant[fetusIndex][property] = value;
    
    // 更新整个数组
    this.setvar(`bf.${female}.pregnant`, pregnant);
    
    console.log(`Updated ${female}'s fetus[${fetusIndex}].${property} to: ${value}`);
});

define('updateCharacterStatus', function(female, options = {}) {
    if(!female || this.variables?.bf?.[female] === null) return;
    this.initFemale(female);
    
    const allowed = [
        'vitality',
        'libido', 
        'uterinePressure'
    ];
    
    for (const key of allowed) {
        if (options[key] !== undefined) {
            // 添加数值验证
            let value = options[key];
            if (typeof value !== 'number' || isNaN(value)) {
                console.log(`Invalid ${key} value: ${value} for ${female}, must be a number`);
                continue;
            }
            
            // 根据属性类型进行范围验证
            switch(key) {
                case 'vitality':
                    if (value < 0 || value > 200) {
                        console.log(`Warning: vitality value ${value} for ${female} is outside valid range [0, 200]`);
                    }
                case 'libido':
                    if (value < 0 || value > 100) {
                        console.log(`Warning: libido value ${value} for ${female} is outside valid range [0, 100]`);
                    }
                case 'uterinePressure':
                    if (value < 0 || value > 150) {
                        console.log(`Warning: uterinePressure value ${value} for ${female} is outside valid range [0, 150]`);
                    }
            }
            
            this.setvar(`bf.${female}.${key}`, value);
        }
    }
    
    console.log(`Updated ${female}'s status:`, options);
});
